variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity redesign proposal A for the cooking/crafting window of the existing Russian cozy farming RPG "Лунная долина". This is a design mockup, not a new game scene.
Input image: the attached screenshot is the exact current interface and a reference for the dimmed gameplay backdrop, warm rustic wooden/pergament material style, and food icons. Redesign the modal only. Remove the oversized ornate gold/wood frame and all of its old UI.
Composition: one polished landscape 16:9 game screenshot, straight-on, crisp readable Russian typography, no perspective, no marketing annotations, no split before/after. A centered horizontal window occupies about 82% screen width and 80% height with a thin dark walnut edge, subtle brass corner fittings, light warm parchment interior. Comfortable consistent spacing and much lighter decoration. Dark forest-green selected states, charcoal-brown readable body text, amber heat indicator, muted brick-red shortages with words/icons too. Headers in a restrained serif, all controls/body in one consistent highly legible sans-serif. The game remains visible dimmed around the modal. Actual food icons should closely resemble the screenshot. Buildable with reusable nine-slice borders and icons, not one massive painted frame.
Variant A: compact recipe LIST at left 52%, detail panel at right 48%. Simple thin divider. Left top search "Найти рецепт…" then tabs "Все", "Горячие", "Заготовки" and small toggle "Доступные". Seven spacious rows with a 40px food icon, name, short availability label on the far right, no comma-separated ingredients in the list. Selected green row "Омлет с зеленью" with check and "Можно готовить"; rows "Молочные блинчики", "Молочная каша", "Домашний майонез" with check; "Овощной суп" with red "Нет овощей"; "Деревенский хлеб" and "Яблочный пирог" grey with lock and "Печь III". A subtle scrollbar.
Title at top left "Домашняя кухня" with smaller subtitle "Домашний очаг · уровень 2", minimal X top right. No gigantic uppercase heading.
Right panel: medium appetizing omelet icon/plate near title "Омлет с зеленью", compact side-by-side green benefit chips "+48 здоровья" and "+8 энергии". Under "Ингредиенты" show two separate readable material rows with egg and milk icons, exact labels "Яйцо" and "Молоко", and green quantities "3 / 2" and "3 / 1" with check marks. Small label "Есть / нужно". The selected recipe yields "1 порция", preparation takes "8 с" at level 2, and costs "1 энергия"; show these in a restrained compact stats row. Quantity control "-   1   +" and button "Макс." with disabled plus/max since stock permits exactly one batch. Prominent forest-green button "В очередь · 1 энергия". Small wording "Ингредиенты спишутся сразу".
Below main content, a compact integrated bottom utility strip, not lots of empty space: flame icon with a small heat bar "Жар 96 / 240", wood icon "Дрова ×12" and a small outlined button "Подкинуть"; adjacent "Очередь 1 / 2" with one soup icon and row "Овощной суп ×1", a paused progress bar, "Осталось 5 с", and one dashed empty queue slot. Opening menus pauses the game, so the queue is explicitly shown paused, not actively cooking. Footer text "Игра на паузе · готовка продолжится после закрытия", keyboard hints "Enter — в очередь" and "Esc — закрыть".
Use correct exact Cyrillic words and specified quantities. Keep menu hierarchy, icon edges and text sharp, substantial readable type sizes; no overlapping elements, no extra portraits, no unrelated modern web-app widgets, no giant empty margins inside the window, no new gameplay scene or invented mechanics.
variants.correction:
Edit the supplied generated cooking-window mockup A. Preserve the entire composition, all illustrations, colors, typography, background, panel dimensions, text, controls and quantities. Make ONLY these two availability-state corrections:
1. The checkbox beside "Доступные" must be clearly UNCHECKED (an empty small box, no tick), because locked/unavailable recipes are visible. Keep this exact caption and leave the selected tab "Все" green.
2. The row "Кукурузный хлеб" requires the third-level oven, just like "Деревенский хлеб". Replace its green check and green "Можно готовить" status with the same muted grey lock and exact "Печь III" used in the first row. Do not change its food icon or name.
All other pixels/words as closely preserved as possible. Do not add, crop, rearrange or blur anything. Exact legible Cyrillic.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity cooking UI redesign proposal B for the existing Russian cozy farming RPG "Лунная долина".
Input images: image 1 is the CURRENT original modal and backdrop; image 2 is redesign A and is ONLY a reference for the lighter parchment/walnut/brass material system, restrained readable typography, consistent green controls, individual ingredients and bottom fuel/paused queue. Produce a NEW alternative B with a GRID OF RECIPE CARDS, not the list in either image. Preserve only the dimmed existing gameplay surroundings.
Single landscape 16:9 game screenshot, straight-on flat UI, crisp Russian text, no split screen or labels about A/B. Centered horizontal modal, lightweight reusable thin walnut rim and tiny brass corners, warm pale parchment, dark readable ink, a forest-green primary action. Avoid thick carved frame, giant decorative header, nested multiple borders, modern web-app chrome, giant empty areas.
Header: "Домашняя кухня", smaller "Домашний очаг · уровень 2", small X top right.
Left 56%: search "Найти рецепт…"; tabs "Все" selected, "Горячие", "Заготовки"; optional small filter "Доступные" with a CLEARLY EMPTY unchecked square (locked recipes are visible).
A spacious 3-column by 3-row grid. Each recipe card has a clear medium illustrated icon from the food style of the source screenshot, its short name under it in readable type, and a small status. No ingredient lists inside cards. Row 1: selected green outlined "Омлет с зеленью" with "Доступно", "Молочные блинчики" with green check, "Молочная каша" with green check. Row 2: "Овощной суп" with red "Нет овощей", "Домашний майонез" with green check, "Ягодное варенье" with green check. Row 3: "Деревенский хлеб", "Яблочный пирог", "Кукурузный хлеб": ALL THREE must have the grey lock icon and "Печь III", because level 2 cannot bake any of them. Natural 2-line names permitted, even card dimensions and all nine cards fully visible, understated small scrollbar.
Right 44%, clearly aligned selected recipe detail: omelet plate beside title "Омлет с зеленью"; green effect pills "+48 здоровья" and "+8 энергии". Under "Ингредиенты" with "Есть / нужно", individual egg and milk rows "Яйцо" with "3 / 2" and green check, "Молоко" with "3 / 1" and green check. Compact stats "1 порция", "8 с", "1 энергия". Quantity control "-  1  +" and disabled "Макс.", disabled minus and plus, because the example allows exactly one batch. Large dark green button "В очередь · 1 энергия", small line "Ингредиенты спишутся сразу". Details must be informative and compact.
Bottom full-width utility strip: flame and heat bar "Жар 96 / 240"; wood icon "Дрова ×12"; outlined "Подкинуть" button; "Очередь 1 / 2", soup icon with "Овощной суп ×1", partially filled PAUSED progress bar, "Пауза", "Осталось 5 с" and an empty dashed queue slot. Do not imply active cooking while menu open.
Footer "Игра на паузе · готовка продолжится после закрытия", "Enter — в очередь", "Esc — закрыть".
Keep specified Cyrillic words and numbers accurate. Visually consistent with redesign A but clearly differentiated by the nine larger food cards. Finished cozy game UI, good typography hierarchy, tiny restrained shadows, no characters/portraits added, no invented systems.
